title: Starting out good
text:
I think these are coming from Music direct. The wall is $49.99 there.
They're single albums are now running ~$35 so $25 not a bad deal.
You can't open plastic wrapping and return. But if you don't open you can return.
It's free return. So not much risk.
I'll give it a shot.
I'll change my rating after a couple months.
label: neutral
